Record Class ModelInfoFile.ClassInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.foundation.ike.model.ModelInfoFile.ClassInfo
Record Components:
kind - the kind of type, as written: ClassInfo, ProfileInfo, or SimpleTypeInfo
namespace - the namespace, as written, empty when none
name - the name, as written
qualifiedName - the name qualified by the model
identifier - the profile identifier
label - the label
baseType - the base class, qualified, empty when none
retrievable - whether a library may retrieve it
primaryCodePath - the element carrying the code
primaryValueSetPath - the element carrying the value set
target - the class of another model it stands on
description - the short description
definition - the definition
comment - the comment
elements - its elements, in the file's order
relationships - how it reaches contexts
searches - how many search parameters the file gives it, set aside
Enclosing class:
ModelInfoFile
public static record ModelInfoFile.ClassInfo(String kind, String namespace, String name, String qualifiedName, String identifier, String label, String baseType, boolean retrievable, String primaryCodePath, String primaryValueSetPath, String target, String description, String definition, String comment, List<ModelInfoFile.Element> elements, List<ModelInfoFile.Relationship> relationships, int searches) extends Record
One class as the file writes it.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
